usedFor: Hiring teams use HackerRank to screen developers, and “Send Assessment to Candidate” invites someone to a chosen test.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Assessment to Candidate” in HackerRank
bestTemplate.why: It invites a candidate to the assessment you choose, so screening starts without a manual email.

watchOut: An invitation reaches a candidate outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
